% A file outside the document's folder, test/abspath-above/glossary.tex,
% that names itself like glossary.4ht with \ProvidesFile, read with the
% primitive \input by a relative path with "..":
% \input ../abspath-above/glossary. A file the writer names by its path is
% the document's. As in the PDF, the file's text is in the page.
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand\absread[2]{\expandafter\def\csname abs#1\endcsname{#2}}
\input ../abspath-above/glossary
\begin{document}
Above: \absabove
\end{document}
